lead: A rebuild of the bench `crates/nvs-ext/benches/image_guest.rs` takes six to ten minutes, even after a one-line edit.
body: The bench profile is release with thin LTO over wasmtime, so every edit relinks the whole binary. To take the figures again without editing, run the binary it built, `target/release/deps/image_guest-<hash>.exe --record`, which takes seconds; the hash is on the `Running` line of the first build.
